title: What's new: Data Analysis
summary: This short video covers new data analysis features in Business Central 2026 release wave 2. Analysis mode now shows the system fields created by, created on, modified by and modified on in the columns menu. Bookmarking an analysis view or a list view to the role center is shown, and the speaker says the analysis bookmark comes in a minor version (29.x), not the major release. Profiles can now add the system fields to pages through the page designer and can carry the bookmarks. The video ends with a pointer to aka.ms/bc-analytics for more on ad hoc data analysis.

features.name: System fields in analysis mode
features.description: The system fields created by, created on, modified by and modified on exist on all tables and are now always available in the columns menu in analysis mode, even if the list page does not show them. Demoed on the sales order list and the customer list.

features.name: Bookmark an analysis view
features.description: A new bookmark view option in the analysis view menu puts the view on the role center. It is meant for views that users treat as mini reports.
features.status_evidence_quote: which is something that is not in the major release, but coming in a minor
caveats: Not in the major release; expected in a minor version 29.x, hopefully one of the first

features.name: Bookmark a list view
features.description: The same bookmark view action is added to normal list views (saved filters), shown on the open sales orders view under the ellipsis. The list view is then bookmarked on the role center.

features.name: System audit fields on pages through profiles
features.description: In the page designer, when adding fields to a page for a profile, the system fields (created at, created by and so on) can be chosen. The example adds modified by, as user name or full name, to the sales order card for all users of that profile.
prerequisites: A profile whose pages are customized in the page designer

features.name: Bookmarks added to profiles
features.description: Bookmarked analysis views and list views can be added to the role center of a profile, so all users sharing that profile get them.
caveats: Bookmarking of analysis views is announced for a minor version 29.x
